texts: A heart transplant biopsy graded mild (1R) with no antibody-mediated rejection (AMR0) needs no treatment: A.
In the picture, a few scattered soldier ants wander on the walls of the new hotel and hardly bite, and Dr Kureha sends the patient home.
Grade 1R rejection usually settles by itself, and treating it would only add the harms of more immunosuppression; it is followed with surveillance biopsies.
Pulse steroids are given for grade 2R or higher, or for rejection with haemodynamic compromise, and IVIg with rituximab for antibody-mediated rejection.
Memory hook: a few ants that hardly bite: no treatment, just watch.
